name: ELDERLY VISITOR
description: An elderly woman who appears in the museum theatre. She wears a dark scarf with a silver bird brooch pinned to it. She has a connection to Mara and demonstrates familiarity with her vocal delivery.

explicit_evidence.quote: The visitor looks toward the stage instead of answering.

inferred_traits.value: knew Mara or was familiar with her work
inferred_traits.rationale: The visitor's comment about Mara rushing a line and her presence in the theatre suggest prior knowledge of or relationship with Mara.
When asked directly if she knew Mara, the visitor looks toward the stage instead of answering, suggesting reluctance to engage.

dialogue_summary: The elderly visitor makes a single comment about Mara rushing a line, then declines to answer a direct question about knowing Mara.

relationships.evidence: The visitor demonstrates familiarity with Mara's vocal delivery and appears to have known her or known of her.
